claims.text: Galcanezumab for episodic cluster headache: 300 mg SC (three 100 mg injections) at the onset of the cluster period, then monthly until it ends.
claims.quote: The recommended dosage of EMGALITY is 300 mg (three consecutive subcutaneous injections of 100 mg each) at the onset of the cluster period, and then monthly until the end of the cluster period.
claims.locator: 2.2 Recommended Dosing for Episodic Cluster Headache
